Simple by design

A small ritual for the cats you notice.

The public map moves quickly. Your Journal keeps the memory. Every step is designed to reward care, not chasing.

01

Spot

Use the camera when you meet a cat out in the world. Camera capture is required for streaks.

02

Check

A quick check confirms there is a cat and keeps duplicate or unsafe posts out.

03

Pin

Your sighting appears as a delayed, approximate area—not an exact point.

04

Collect

Earn a little XP, grow your streak, and keep the cat in your private Journal.

Protection comes first

A softer map for a more careful world.

Pawprint is playful, but cats are not collectibles to be chased. Safety features are part of the core product.

  • ✓Approximate and 5-minute delayed
    Public pins appear after a 5-minute safety delay, never reveal exact locations, and do not show live movement.
  • ✓Photo privacy
    Camera snapshots are re-encoded before storage, removing GPS metadata before a photo is stored or shared.
  • ✓Care Flags
    Mark a cat that may need help without pretending to diagnose.
  • ✓Easy reporting
    Unsafe spots, harmful content, and privacy concerns can be surfaced quickly.
  • ✓Human behaviour matters
    Reminders help people avoid chasing, touching, or using flash at night.

Why I’m building Pawprint

I’m building Pawprint because noticing street cats should lead to care, not chasing. The product turns a small moment into a safer shared record while keeping locations approximate and delayed.

Install on your phone

Keep Pawprint one tap away.

The browser app works on phones today and can be added to your home screen without an app store.

iPhone or iPad

Open Pawprint in Safari, tap Share, then choose Add to Home Screen.

Android phone

Open Pawprint in Chrome, tap the menu, then choose Add to Home screen or Install app.

Questions, answered

Before you leave a trace.

Is Pawprint free?

Yes. Core spotting, Journal, Care Flags, reporting, and safety tools are designed to stay free.

What happens to a photo after 24 hours?

The public map pin expires after 24 hours. Your private Journal entry remains until you delete it or your account.

Is it safe for cats?

Public pins are approximate and delayed, with no live tracking. Observe from a distance and never chase, touch, or use flash at night.

Is there a minimum age?

The preview is still finalizing its minimum-age and consent policy. Parents or guardians should supervise younger users until that policy is published.

Does Pawprint work on iPhone?

Yes. The browser app works in Safari and can be added to the home screen. Native iOS and Android apps are coming soon.

Privacy, in plain language

Exact coordinates are never shown publicly. Photos are camera-captured, re-encoded to remove GPS metadata, and public pins are delayed and approximate. You can export or delete your account.

Community terms

Share observations responsibly: do not chase cats, reveal private property, upload people, or use Pawprint for live tracking. Safety tools are available to everyone.

Contact

For project questions or partnership interest, use the project owner’s LinkedIn message. Verified shelters and rescue groups will be listed only after a real partnership is confirmed.

Filipino / English

Hanapin ang pusa. Mag-iwan ng bakas. A Filipino language option is available in the app and the full landing-page translation is next.
